# PR #3271: Patch: a named set of width and height breakpoints for every stylesheet

Closes #3227

The web client's screen-size breakpoints are now one named set in `apps/web/src/breakpoints.ts`, and a new test holds every stylesheet and script to it. This follows the issue's option (b), which needs no new package. Specs 46 and 47, the web unit suite and the PR checks I could run pass. One component spec beyond the plan's seven fails, and it fails the same way with `main`'s stylesheets (under Testing).

## What changed

- **`apps/web/src/breakpoints.ts`** (new) names five values:
  - `phone` 600 px wide
  - `narrow` 760 px wide
  - `medium` 899 px wide
  - `tablet` 1024 px wide (the desktop starts at 1025)
  - `short` 500 px tall
  
  Each value is the largest size of the smaller layout: `upTo()` gives `(max-width: N)` and `over()` gives `(min-width: N+1)`, so no width matches both. The file also exports `COARSE_POINTER_QUERY` and `PHONE_SHEET_QUERY`.
- **38 `@media` queries in 18 stylesheets** moved onto the nearest named value. Only the query line changed, and no blocks were merged.
  - The off-by-one pairs collapse: 560/561, 720/721, 619/620, 900 against `min-width: 900`, and `(min-width: 600px)` beside `(max-width: 600px)` in `tavern.css`, `code-field.css` and `landing.css`.
  - Heights of 520–560 px join `short` (500).
  - The three range-syntax queries (`width <= …`) are rewritten as `max-width`.
- **Six scripts** now build their queries from the module: `game/config.ts` (4 constants), `tutorial/config.ts`, `game/craft/CraftEditor.tsx`, `patches/constants.ts`, `routes/devPanel.ts` and `shortcuts/shortcuts.ts`. Every resulting string is unchanged.
- **`apps/web/src/breakpoints.test.ts`** (new) has six `#3227` tests. They fail on:
  - any size in a sheet's `@media` that is neither named nor listed in `KEEP` with its reason;
  - range syntax or a non-px value;
  - any value that is both a max and a min on the same axis;
  - a script query that differs from its named value;
  - any script but `breakpoints.ts` that spells a size query itself. The only exception, in `SCRIPT_KEEP`, is `DeckWorkshop.tsx`'s 1100 px, which mirrors `workshop.css`.
- **Docs and one test:** a breakpoints paragraph in `apps/web/README.md`; `docs/polish/6-cards.md` now says 600 px instead of 560; `routes/stats.test.tsx` now reads the drilldown's block at 600 instead of 640.

| Revert one change and rerun the new test (`tavern.css` 818 to `min-width: 600px`, `prompt.css` 643 to range syntax, `constants.ts` to a literal) | Fails each time; all restored |
| `pnpm --dir apps/web test` | 538 files, 9980 passed, 6 skipped |
| `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web` | Pass |
| `cargo fmt --check`, `catalog check`, `patches check`, `spec check` | Pass (`spec check`: 1772 rulings, ok) |

| e2e spec 46 (menus fit one screen), Chrome, E2E server + `build:e2e` client | 54 passed |

- **The `deckbuilder-layout` failure:** "at 390x844 with a full deck open, the first row of the pool is on the first screen" fails with 865 px, over the 844 px limit. It fails identically when I put `main`'s 18 stylesheets back, and none of my moves changes which side of a query a 390x844 window falls on. // #3227: the client's named breakpoints; breakpoints.test.ts holds every sheet's `@media` and every script's
// query to them or to its KEEP. Each is the widest (or tallest) window of the smaller layout: `(max-width: N)`
// holds up to N and the layout above starts at `(min-width: N + 1)`, so no width matches both.

/** In CSS px. Wider than `tablet` is the desktop. */
export const BREAKPOINT_PX = {
  /** A phone held upright: the touch rule's and the top bar's (R2122000, R3218000). */
  phone: 600,
  /** A small tablet held upright: the board's narrow cards, the deck builder's one column. */
  narrow: 760,
  /** A tablet held upright: the menus' two columns, and a landscape tablet's desktop board, start at 900. */
  medium: 899,
  /** A tablet either way up: the desktop layout starts at 1025. */
  tablet: 1024,
  /** A phone on its side: at most this tall. */
  short: 500,
} as const;

export type Breakpoint = keyof typeof BREAKPOINT_PX;

const AXIS: Readonly<Record<Breakpoint, "width" | "height">> = { phone: "width", narrow: "width", medium: "width", tablet: "width", short: "height" };

/** At or under `name`: `(max-width: 600px)`. */
export function upTo(name: Breakpoint): string {
  return `(max-${AXIS[name]}: ${String(BREAKPOINT_PX[name])}px)`;
}

/** Past `name`: `(min-width: 601px)`. */
export function over(name: Breakpoint): string {
  return `(min-${AXIS[name]}: ${String(BREAKPOINT_PX[name] + 1)}px)`;
}

/** The touch query: a coarse main pointer. */
export const COARSE_POINTER_QUERY = "(pointer: coarse)";

/** A phone either way up: the board's match bar, the coach's dock, the craft editor's sheet. */
export const PHONE_SHEET_QUERY = `${upTo("phone")}, (orientation: landscape) and ${upTo("short")}`;
```
